blocks.en: Abstract
blocks.zh: 摘要

blocks.en:
Constrained generation aims to sample from language models (LMs) conditioned on hard constraints. Existing constrained-generation techniques for nondeterministic finite automaton (NFA) constraints either distort the distribution or sacrifice efficiency. Theoretically, this task reduces to counting the length- n n sequences accepted by an NFA (#NFA), and the exact #NFA problem is #P-complete. Recent work has shown that
#NFA admits a fully polynomial randomized approximation scheme (FPRAS). Inspired by this result, we propose NFA-LM , a polynomial-time engine for NFA-constrained generation with theoretical guarantees under mild assumptions. Experiments show that NFA-LM efficiently generates high-quality outputs with theoretically bounded approximation error.
blocks.zh:
约束生成旨在从以硬约束为条件的语言模型(LM)中取样. 现有的有限生成技术对非决定性的有限自体(NFA)的制约或者扭曲分布或者牺牲效率. 理论上,这个任务会减少计算一个NFA(#NFA)接受的长度-n序列,而准确的#NFA问题就是#P-完成. 最近的工作表明,
#NFA承认完全多元随机近似计划(FPRAS). 受这一结果的启发,我们提出NFA-LM,这是用于NFA受约束一代的多诺时引擎,在轻度假设下具有理论保障. 实验显示,NFA-LM在理论上有边界近似差错的情况下高效生成高质量的输出.

blocks.en: 1 Introduction
blocks.zh: 导言

blocks.en: As language models (LMs) become ubiquitous across a wide range of tasks, the demand for constrained generation , which requires outputs to satisfy specific constraints, continues to grow. Constrained-generation techniques benefit downstream applications such as text detoxification ( Gehman et al., 2020 ; Weng et al., 2025 ) , agentic function calling ( Patil et al., 2024 ; Patil et al., 2025 ; OpenAI, 2024 ) , and structured SQL generation ( Lei et al., 2025 ) . Regular expressions (Regex) ( Kleene, 1956 ) are a powerful tool for modeling such constraints and can be represented efficiently by NFAs with a linear number of states ( Thompson, 1968 ; Glushkov, 1961 ) .
blocks.zh: 随着语言模型(LMs)在一系列广泛任务中变得无所不在,对限制生成(需要产出来满足具体制约因素)的需求继续增长。 约束生成技术有利于下游应用,如文本解毒(Gehman等人,2020年;Weng等人,2025年),代理功能调用(Patil等人,2006年)。 2024; Patil等人,2025;OpenAI,2024),以及结构化的SQL生成(Lei等人,2025). 正则表达式(Regex)(Kleene,1956年)是模拟这种制约的有力工具,可以由线性数态的NFAs有效代表(Thompson,1968年;Glushkov,1961年).

blocks.en:
Given an LM P lm P_{\text{lm}} and a constraint α \alpha , constrained generation seeks to sample outputs from P lm ( x 1 : n ∣ α ) P_{\text{lm}}(x_{1:n}\mid\alpha) . At step ℓ \ell , this is equivalent to sampling x ℓ x_{\ell} from a distribution proportional to P lm ( x ℓ ∣ x 1 : ℓ − 1 ) ⋅ P lm ( α ∣ x 1 : ℓ − 1 ⋅ x ℓ ) P_{\text{lm}}(x_{\ell}\mid x_{1:\ell-1})\cdot P_{\text{lm}}(\alpha\mid x_{1:\ell-1}\cdot x_{\ell}) . The main difficulty lies in computing the constraint-conditioned probability P lm ( α ∣ x 1 : ℓ ) P_{\text{lm}}(\alpha\mid x_{1:\ell}) , which requires marginalizing over future continuations: ∑ x ℓ + 1 : n : x 1 : n satisfies α P lm ( x ℓ + 1 : n ∣ x 1 : ℓ ) \underset{x_{\ell+1:n}:x_{1:n}\text{ satisfies }\alpha}{\sum}P_{\text{lm}}(x_{\ell+1:n}\mid x_{1:\ell}) . The unweighted special case of computing
the number of suffixes x ℓ + 1 : n x_{\ell+1:n} such that x 1 : n x_{1:n} satisfies α \alpha , given a prefix x 1 : ℓ x_{1:\ell} , is a #NFA problem, which is known to be #P-complete ( Àlvarez and Jenner, 1993 ) . Existing constrained-generation techniques fall into two categories based on the tradeoff between efficiency and distribution preservation. (i) Distribution-agnostic techniques, such as PICARD ( Scholak et al., 2021 ) , Synchromesh ( Poesia et al., 2022 ) , and XGrammar ( Dong et al., 2025 ; Li et al., 2026 ) , mask out tokens that violate the constraint using explicit decoding-time checkers. These approaches efficiently determine whether P lm ( α ∣ x 1 : ℓ ) P_{\text{lm}}(\alpha\mid x_{1:\ell}) is zero, but they distort the true conditional distribution ( Park et al., 2024 ; Melcer et al., 2026 ) . (ii) Distribution-aware techniques seek to preserve P lm ( α ∣ x 1 : ℓ ) P_{\text{lm}}(\alpha\mid x_{1:\ell}) . Existing approaches, such as Langevin-based methods ( Kumar et al., 2022 ; Qin et al., 2022 ) , MCMC samplers ( Amini et al., 2023 ; Gonzalez et al., 2025 ) , and SMC-based methods ( Lew et al., 2023 ; Zhao et al., 2024 ; Loula et al., 2025 ; Lipkin et al., 2025 ) , generally lack polynomial-time guarantees for approximating the constrained LM distribution to a prescribed accuracy. Recently, a line of research distills Hidden Markov Model (HMM) P hmm ( α ∣ x 1 : ℓ ) ≈ P lm ( α ∣ x 1 : ℓ ) P_{\text{hmm}}(\alpha\mid x_{1:\ell})\approx P_{\text{lm}}(\alpha\mid x_{1:\ell}) as a tractable proposal: GeLaTo ( Zhang et al., 2023 ) and Ctrl-G ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) develop efficient algorithms that compute P hmm ( α ∣ x 1 : ℓ ) P_{\text{hmm}}(\alpha\mid x_{1:\ell}) exactly for DFAs and handle basic constraints such as keyword inclusion and length requirements, but general Regex still requires up to exponentially many DFA states ( Moore, 1971 ) .

blocks.en: Consequently, LMs still struggle with constrained generation ( Geng et al., 2025 ; Sun et al., 2023 ; Lu et al., 2023 ) . This raises a research question: Can we achieve efficient distribution-aware constrained generation for NFAs with theoretically bounded error? We answer this question affirmatively with NFA-LM . Our framework is theoretically inspired by efficient FPRAS for #NFA ( Arenas et al., 2021 ; Meel and de Colnet, 2025 ) , and generalizes Ctrl-G ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) to NFA case. NFA-LM first distills an HMM from the base LM and uses it to assign tractable probability weights to future continuations. It then generalizes the #NFA FPRAS to estimate the HMM completion weight P hmm ( α ∣ x 1 : ℓ ) P_{\text{hmm}}(\alpha\mid x_{1:\ell}) to reweight the LM’s next-token distribution.
blocks.zh: 因此,LMs仍然与受限制的一代人作斗争(Geng等人,2025年;Sun等人,2023年;Lu等人,2023年)。 这就提出了一个研究问题: 我们能否在理论上设定错误的情况下,实现有效分配意识限制的NFA生成? 我们肯定地回答NFA-LM的问题。 我们的框架在理论上受到#NFA的高效FPRAS(Arenas等人,2021年;Meel and de Colnet,2025年)的启发,将Ctrl-G(Zhang等人,2024年)概括为NFA案例. NFA-LM首先从基LM中提炼出一个HMM,并用它来为未来的续作分配可携带概率权重. 然后将 #NFA FPRAS 概括为估算 HMM 完成重量 Pmm( α ∣ x 1 : l ) P_{\ text{ hmm}}(\ alpha\mid x_{1 :\ell}), 以重置 LM 的下一个音箱分布 。

blocks.en: We organize the rest of the paper as follows. We introduce the preliminaries in Section 2 , followed by the key concepts of canonical runs in Section 3 . We present NFA-LM in Section 4 and its main theoretical guarantees in Section 5 . We empirically evaluate NFA-LM in Section 6 and conclude in Section 7 . Complete engineering details and proofs appear in Appendices A , B , and C .

3 Canonical Runs on an NFA
blocks.zh: 3次NFA的加冕赛

blocks.en: In this section, we summarize the unrolling procedure and canonical runs that are key to the algorithm description and theoretical analysis.
blocks.zh: 在本节中,我们总结了对算法描述和理论分析至关重要的不滚动程序和犬科运行.

blocks.en: Given n ∈ ℕ + n\in\mathbb{N}^{+} , we can unroll the NFA A A into A u = ( Q u , Σ , T u , q 0 0 , q F n ) A^{u}=(Q^{u},\Sigma,T^{u},q_{0}^{0},q_{F}^{n}) with the property L ⁡ ( A u ) = L n ​ ( A ) L(A^{u})=L_{n}(A) . blocks.en: Overall, NFA-LM consists of three stages: (i) Distillation: following Zhang et al. (2023) ; Zhang et al. (2024) , we distill an HMM P hmm P_{\text{hmm}} using responses sampled from the base LM P lm P_{\text{lm}} ; (ii) Precomputation: we precompute HMM-weighted suffix samples that provide reusable information for constrained generation; and (iii) Generation: we use the precomputed information to generate outputs. blocks.en:
Following the experimental setups of prior constrained-generation work ( Zhang et al., 2023 ; Zhang et al., 2024 ; Dang et al., 2026 ) , we evaluate NFA-LM on
CommonGen ( Lin et al., 2020 ) , in which each instance includes three to five key concepts as input and the goal is to generate a sequence that incorporates these concepts. Table 1 presents 10 Regex constraint families that are difficult for DFAs, with difficulty controlled by the parameters k 1 k_{1} and k 2 k_{2} (where k 2 k_{2} is the number of tracked keywords). To increase the number of tracked keywords k 2 k_{2} , we augment CommonGen to include up to 20 tracked keywords by merging distinct raw instances. We randomly sample 500 instances from the constraint families, difficulty parameters, and tracked keywords, with the number of NFA states limited to 50. We also require each output sequence to contain between 1 and 64 tokens.
blocks.zh:
在对先前的有限生产工作进行实验(Zhang等人,2023年;Zhang等人,2024年;Dang等人,2026年)之后,我们对NFA-LM进行了评估。
CommunityGen(Lin et al.,2020年),其中每个实例包含三至五个关键概念作为投入,目标是生成一个包含这些概念的序列. 表1列出10个对DFA有困难的Regex约束家族,难度由参数k k 1 k_{1}和k 2 k_{2}(其中k 2 k_{2}是履带关键词的数量)控制. 为了增加履带关键词K 2 k_{2},我们增加了CommonGen,通过合并不同的原始实例,包括多达20个履带关键词。 我们随机抽取了500例来自制约家族,难度参数,以及跟踪关键词,NFA的状态数量限制在50个. 我们还要求每个输出序列包含1到64个符号.

blocks.en:
We evaluate the proprietary model GPT-5.6 Luna via the OpenAI API, as well as the open-source models Qwen3.5-2B and Gemma-4-E2B ( Team, 2026 ; Team et al., 2026 ) , as LM baselines. We distill a 128-state HMM for each open-source model.
We compare our method against the distribution-agnostic framework XGrammar ( Dong et al., 2025 ) and the distribution-aware method Ctrl-G ( Zhang et al., 2024 ) . For NFA-LM , we set the theoretical parameters to ( ε , δ ) = ( 0.1 , 0.1 ) (\varepsilon,\delta)=(0.1,0.1) . For Ctrl-G, we convert the Regex constraints to optimal-size DFAs. We conduct the experiments on one NVIDIA L40S (48 GB) GPU and 10 Intel Xeon Gold 6448Y CPU cores, with a timeout of 256 seconds.

我们通过OpenAI API评价专有模型GPT-5.6 Luna,以及开源模型Qwen3.5-2B和Gemma-4-E2B(Team,2026年;Team等人,2026年),作为LM基线. 我们为每个开源模型提炼出128态的HMM.
我们比较我们的方法与分布-不可知框架XGrammar(Dong等人,2025年)和分布-认识方法Ctrl-G(Zhang等人,2024年). 对于NFA-LM,我们设定理论参数为( ,δ)=(0.1,0.1)(\varepsilon,\delta)=(0.1,0.1). 对于Ctrl-G,我们将Regex限制转换为最佳尺寸的DFA. 我们进行了一个NVIDIA L40S(48 GB)GPU和10个英特尔Xeon Gold 6448Y CPU核心的实验,超时256秒.

blocks.en: 6.1 RQ1: Scalability
blocks.zh: 6.1 RQ1: 可缩放性

blocks.en:
Overall, NFA-LM efficiently scales to large Regex instances.
As shown in Table 2 , NFA-LM satisfies the constraints on all 500 instances, with an average runtime of 28.5 seconds for Gemma-4-E2B, whereas Ctrl-G succeeds on fewer than half of the instances under the timeout limit.
These compact NFAs can require exponentially larger DFAs (Table 1 ), and Figure 2 shows that Ctrl-G’s failures are concentrated among larger constraints, while NFA-LM remains tractable. The LLM-only baselines are the fastest but satisfy only 38.0–61.2% of the constraints, highlighting the difficulty of the Regex constraints.
blocks.zh:
总体而言,NFA-LM能有效地对大型Regex案例进行衡量。
如表2所示,NFA-LM满足了所有500例的制约,Gemma-4-E2B的平均运行时间为28.5秒,而Ctrl-G在超时限下成功的次数不到一半。
这些紧凑的NFA可以要求指数较大的DFA(表1),图2显示,Ctrl-G的故障集中在更大的制约因素中,而NFA-LM仍然可以被引导. 仅LLM的基线是最快的,但只满足38.0-61.2 %的制约,凸显了Regex制约的困难.

blocks.en: 6.3 RQ3: Generation Quality
blocks.zh: 6.3 RQ3: 生成质量

blocks.en:
We average quality scores over each method’s constraint-satisfying outputs. Overall, Gemma-4-E2B yields higher average quality than Qwen3.5-2B for every method. On their respective successful subsets, Ctrl-G scores slightly higher than NFA-LM . This is because Ctrl-G computes the exact value of P hmm ( α ∣ ⋅ ) {P}_{\text{hmm}}(\alpha\mid\cdot) , while NFA-LM computes an approximate value. Both NFA-LM and XGrammar succeed on all instances, but NFA-LM achieves substantially higher average quality than XGrammar. The following CommonGen example uses the concepts (tracked keywords) [hair, use, uses, iron, curl, actress] with the both_sides constraint. The word “and” is selected as the separator. XGrammar generates “The actress uses an iron to curl her hair for a dramatic effect. end end … and uses” (with 46 repetitions of “end” omitted), while NFA-LM generates “The actress uses an iron to curl her hair for her role and uses the style in the film.”
Both outputs satisfy the constraint because “uses” appears on both sides of the separator “and”. However, XGrammar repeats “end” 46 times and delays satisfying the constraint until near the length limit, earning a judge grade of 1.5. In contrast, NFA-LM produces a shorter, more natural sentence with a judge grade of 3.0. Overall, NFA-LM generates high-quality sequences and outperforms distribution-agnostic methods.

我们在每个方法的制约性产出上的平均质量得分。 总体而言,Gemma-4-E2B每种方法的平均质量都高于Quen3.5-2B. 在各自的成功子集上,Ctrl-G的得分略高于NFA-LM. 这是因为 Ctrl-G 计算 Pmm( α ∣ ) { P}_{\ text{ hmm}}( alpha\ mid\ cdot) 的确切值, 而 NFA- LM 计算一个大致值 。 NFA-LM和XGrammar在所有情况下都成功,但NFA-LM的平均质量大大高于XGrammar. 以下CommonGen的例子使用概念(有轨关键词)[头发,使用,使用,铁,卷,女演员]与双侧制约. “和”一词被选为分隔符。 XGrammar 生成 “女演员用铁来卷发, 结尾.和使用(删去了46个“结束”的重复),而NFA-LM生成 “女演员用铁来卷住头发, “
这两种产出都满足了这一限制因素,因为“使用”出现在分隔符的两侧“和”。 然而,XGrammar重复“结束”46次,并拖延到接近时限时才满足限制,法官级别为1.5。 相比之下,NFA-LM产生更短,更自然的判决,法官等级为3.0. 总体而言,NFA-LM产生高质量的序列,并且超越分布-不可知的方法.

blocks.en: 7 Conclusion
blocks.zh: 7 结论

blocks.en: We introduced NFA-LM , a polynomial-time approach to distribution-aware constrained generation for NFA constraints. It adapts the #NFA FPRAS to estimate HMM-weighted accepting completions and uses these estimates to guide LM generation with theoretical guarantees. NFA-LM efficiently generates high-quality outputs with provably bounded approximation error for NFA constraints at scale.
blocks.zh: 我们引入了NFA-LM, 一种多时方法, 它调整了#NFA FPRAS,以估计HMM加权接受完成,并利用这些估计以理论保证来指导LM生成. NFA-LM高效地产生高质量的产出,并具有可证明的极限性近似误差,用于规模的NFA限制.

blocks.en: Limitations
blocks.zh: 限制

blocks.en: First, NFA-LM focuses on Regex constraints represented by NFAs, motivated by the efficient FPRAS for #NFA ( Meel and de Colnet, 2025 ) . Richer constraints such as context-free languages and nonregular Regex features such as backreferences still remain as challenges. Although an FPRAS for #CFG was recently established ( Meel and de Colnet, 2026 ) , its best-known running time is still O ⁡ ( g 14 ​ n 57 ​ ε − 4 ​ log ⁡ ( δ − 1 ) ) O(g^{14}n^{57}\varepsilon^{-4}\log(\delta^{-1})) for a Chomsky-normal-form grammar of size g g , a sequence of length n n , and error parameters ( ε , δ ) (\varepsilon,\delta) , which remains impractical for constrained generation.
blocks.zh: 首先,NFA-LM侧重于NFA代表的Regex限制,其动机是有效的FPRAS for #NFA(Meel and de Colnet, 2025). 较丰富的制约因素,例如无上下文语言和不正规的Regex特征,例如回溯参考,仍然是一项挑战。 虽然最近为#CFG建立了一个FPRAS(Meel and de Colnet, 2026),但其最著名的运行时间仍然是O QQ(g 14 n 57 QQ – 4 log ). O(g^{14}n^{57}\varepsilon^{-4}\log(\delta^{-1})),为大小gg的乔姆斯基-正常形式语法,长度n n的序列,以及错误参数(ε,δ)(\varepsilon,\delta),对于受限制的生成来说仍然是不切实际的.

blocks.en:
Second, NFA-LM relies on a distilled HMM as a proxy for the LM’s completion probabilities: P hmm ( α ∣ x 1 : ℓ ) ≈ P lm ( α ∣ x 1 : ℓ ) P_{\text{hmm}}(\alpha\mid x_{1:\ell})\approx P_{\text{lm}}(\alpha\mid x_{1:\ell}) . Our guarantees bound the weighted-#NFA approximation error relative to exact HMM-guided decoding, but they do not bound this HMM-to-LM approximation. Future work includes extending the guarantees to context-free constraints and
reducing or eliminating our reliance on the HMM.
blocks.zh:
第二,NFA-LM依靠蒸馏的HMM作为LM完成概率的代名词: Pmm (α ∣ x 1: l). ≈ pm (α ∣ x 1 : l ) P_{\ text{(\ alpha\mid x_{1 :\ ell})\大约 P_{\ text{lm}}(\ alpha\mid x_{1:\ell}) 。 我们的保证将加权-#NFA的近似误差与精确的HMM制导解码绑定在一起,但它们并没有将这个HMM对LM的近似绑定. 今后的工作包括扩大保障范围,使之包括无环境限制和限制。
减少或消除我们对《不扩散条约》的依赖。

blocks.en: Appendix A Cached Membership
blocks.zh: 附 录 A

blocks.en:

blocks.en: LM quality-judge prompt ⬇ You are a strict quality evaluator of English paragraphs . Evaluate the quality of the following paragraph according to the following grading scheme . For each criterion , assign a grade of 1, 2, 3, or 4. Return the average grade . 1. Fluency : grammar , readability , and natural wording . A grade of 4 is well - formed and natural ; a 3 has a tiny error ; a 2 is understandable but has noticeable awkwardness ; a 1 is unreadable . 2. Coherence : semantic reasonableness and internal consistency . A grade of 4 means logical and well connected ; a 3 means broadly consistent but has unclear transitions ; a 2 has a serious consistency issue but is readable ; a 1 makes no semantic sense or is self - contradictory . Put your final score within the delimiters <<< >>> for extraction . Your Task : { output_to_be_graded } Your Score :
